name: plan-furnish-simple
description: PLAN-FURNISH Phase 1 ladder: the 2D-plan 'Furnish' catalog entry + click-to-place are hidden in Simple mode, shown in Pro; arming a def shows an SVG ghost that follows the cursor with green/red canPlace validity; a click on a valid spot commits via addItem/beginDrop/pendingEdit (auto-shows furniture, selects the new item); the placed item is confirmed and visible back in the 3D scene.

steps.name: boot-splash-gone
steps.failMessage: #boot-loader still covering the screen. It is removed from the DOM only once `booting` clears, which depends on sceneReady — measured 751ms and 36604ms across two runs of the SAME scenario, so no fixed wait covers it. Every screenshot before this point is the loader, and nothing fails (v0.31.9.6).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.()

steps.name: verify-no-furnish-button-simple
steps.eval: (function(){ const has = [...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-screen button')].some(b => b.textContent?.trim() === 'Furnish'); if (has) throw new Error('Furnish button should be hidden in Simple mode'); console.log('no Furnish button in Simple — gated correctly'); })()

steps.name: planFurnish-flag-on-pro
steps.failMessage: planFurnish flag should be ON in Pro mode

steps.name: click-furnish-button
steps.eval: (function(){ const b = [...document.querySelectorAll('.plan-screen button')].find(x => x.textContent?.trim() === 'Furnish'); if (!b) throw new Error('Furnish button not found in Pro mode'); b.click(); })()

steps.name: catalog-visible-in-plan
steps.failMessage: Catalog did not surface inside the plan editor

steps.name: ghost-rendered
steps.eval: (function(){ const svg = document.querySelector('.plan-screen svg.plan-paper'); const shapes = [...svg.querySelectorAll('[stroke-dasharray="4 3"]')]; if (shapes.length === 0) throw new Error('no room shapes found'); const r = shapes[0].getBoundingClientRect(); svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: r.left + r.width / 2, clientY: r.top + r.height / 2, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 1 })); })()

steps.name: ghost-layer-present
steps.failMessage: Placement ghost layer did not render for the armed def

steps.name: find-valid-drop-spot
steps.eval: (async function(){ const svg = document.querySelector('.plan-screen svg.plan-paper'); const shapes = [...svg.querySelectorAll('[stroke-dasharray="4 3"]')]; const rects = shapes.map(s => s.getBoundingClientRect()).filter(r => r.width > 40 && r.height > 40); rects.sort((a, b) => b.width * b.height - a.width * a.height); const frame = () => new Promise((res) => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(res))); const offsets = [[0.5,0.5],[0.25,0.25],[0.75,0.25],[0.25,0.75],[0.75,0.75],[0.5,0.25],[0.5,0.75],[0.25,0.5],[0.75,0.5]]; for (const r of rects) { for (const [fx, fy] of offsets) { const x = r.left + r.width * fx; const y = r.top + r.height * fy; svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { clientX: x, clientY: y, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 1 })); await frame(); const g = document.querySelector('[data-plan-ghost="sofa-3seat"]'); if (g && g.getAttribute('data-plan-ghost-valid') === 'true') { window.__planFurnishPt = { x, y }; console.log('found valid drop spot', x, y); return; } } } throw new Error('No valid drop spot found in any room for sofa-3seat — every candidate collided (default flat is pre-furnished)'); })()

steps.name: commit-click
steps.eval: (function(){ const svg = document.querySelector('.plan-screen svg.plan-paper'); const p = window.__planFurnishPt; const opts = { clientX: p.x, clientY: p.y, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, pointerId: 1, button: 0, buttons: 1 }; svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', opts)); svg.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup', opts)); })()

steps.name: item-placed
steps.failMessage: Click did not commit the placement (item not added / still armed)

steps.name: verify-placed-item
steps.eval: (function(){ const st = window.__store.getState(); const it = st.items[st.items.length - 1]; if (it.defId !== 'sofa-3seat') throw new Error('Last item is not the placed sofa: ' + it.defId); if (!st.pendingEdit || st.pendingEdit.kind !== 'placement') throw new Error('Expected a pending placement edit'); if (!st.showFurniture !== false) {} console.log('placed sofa at', it.position, 'rotation', it.rotation); })()
